19 | Unstone | 100cu' | P | 100' | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Puts any animal to sleep. Will not affect enchanted creatures or creatures
with greater than animal intelligence.
@@ 2
Creates a 10-foot radius area where no form of plant life will grow until the
area is healed. Plant life currently in the area will die.
@@ 3
Loosens 100’ cubic feet of earth to the consistency of plowed ground.
@@ 4
Allows the caster to control the actions of any 1 animal.
@@ 5
Any previous cracks or flaws in any natural material up to a 10 feet x 10 feet
x 10 feet section will extend to their limit.
@@ 6
As Blight I, except for the area of effect.
@@ 7
As Animal Sleep I, except it can put up to 3 animals to sleep.
@@ 8
Changes 100 feet of stone to packed earth. This change is gradual (taking
three rounds for complete change).
@@ 9
Creates an area of very sharp spiked stones from rock occurring in the
affected radius. The spikes take one round to form, so anyone in the radius
when it is cast may make a moving maneuver to avoid taking a critical. Any
creature caught in the area when the spikes form suffers a ''B'' Puncture
critical. In addition, anyone moving through the area must make a moving
maneuver or suffer an ''A'' Puncture critical. (GM determines all maneuver
difficulties based on the situation).
@@ 10
Creates a wall of rough-cut stones up to 10 foot x 10 foot x 1 foot. It can be
chipped through. The wall must rest on a solid surface.
@@ 11
Creates a 3 foot by 6 foot corridor that is 1 foot per level long. It can cut
through any non-metal, inorganic material. The corridor is created at a rate
of 1 foot (length) per round as long as the caster concentrates.
@@ 12
As Stone/Earth, except it changes packed earth to solid stone and loose earth
to gravel.
@@ 13
As Animal Mastery I, except the caster can control 3 animals.
@@ 14
As Blight I, except for the area of effect.
@@ 15
As Spike Stones I, except for the area of effect, and the criticals inflicted
are ''C'' and ''B'', respectively.
@@ 16
Disintegrates (i.e., nothing is left) 100 cubic feet of earth.
@@ 17
For as long as he concentrates, caster may mold 1 cubic foot of stone with his
hands as if it were putty; then the stone will harden.
@@ 18
As Stone/Mud, except changes stone to mud.
@@ 19
As Unearth, except it affects stone.
@@ 20
Causes a large crack to open in the ground. The size of the crack will be up
to 10 feet wide, up to 100 feet deep, and up to 200 feet long. The crack takes
two rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the
crevice.
@@ 25
As Blight I, except for the area of effect.
@@ 30
Causes a large crevice to open in the ground (up to 10 foot per level deep, 1
foot per level wide, and 20 foot per level long). The crevice takes two rounds
to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the crevice.
@@ 50
Caster can cause an earthquake, with the spot he touches as the epicenter. The
quake can be delayed up to 1 rnd/lvl. The severity of the quake on the Richter
scale is determined by a d100 roll: (10-20) = 5.5, (21-45) = 6.0, (46-65) =
6.5, (66-80) = 7.0, (81-90) = 7.5, (91.95) = 8.0, (96-98) = 8.5, (99-100) =
9.0.
